paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.18, with a change of -0.16% from the prior close and -16.03% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 7, 2026.

Recent news includes updates about Project Matador and first-quarter results, as well as a sharp selloff and a $375M convertible note deal. Retail traders have turned bullish on the stock despite the selloff, and Cetera Investment Advisers has raised its stock position in Fermi Inc. by 3,262.3% during the first quarter.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings.
